qualified_hardware: MPC Live II + full X-Touch MC/USB
prior_image_acceptance: Earlier images were flashed and booted on the MPC Live II: each upgraded into its own stage, replaced the boot helpers, kept the previous stage and its session files, and ran the controller and the heavy project cleanly. The mouse image was the most recent, flashed over the prior installation with the cursor, click, drag-select and wheel confirmed on the flashed build.
runtime_acceptance: v0.2.0 runtime on the owner's Live II, owner-confirmed 2026-09-16: the X-Touch jog wheel as the MPC data wheel (Scrub toggles, LED lit in scrub mode), the cursor cluster's data steps and Tab/Shift+Tab focus navigation, the footswitches as Play and Record, and the USB mouse (cursor at boot and on hot-plug, click, drag-select and the wheel as the focused control's data wheel at slow and fast speeds). The heavy-project repair is retained and unchanged: no clicks with eight concurrent faders, unplug/reconnect and Drum Mix on the project that previously clicked. Two controls are built and exercised by the regressions but disabled in the shipped bridge and not on the device: the centre-button Enter and one-press Duplicate Sequence, held back pending an asynchronous redesign. Known limit: a fast wheel spin on some sliders (volume) overshoots.
image_acceptance: The v0.2.0 image has not yet been flashed or booted on hardware. Its stage install, upgrade path (preserving prior stages and session files, replacing boot helpers) and payload are verified in an extracted ARM filesystem only; systemd ordering, boot and flash remain untested until the owner flashes it (Gate 1). The shipped observer and bridge are the owner-confirmed stable build's source rebuilt for the v0.2.0 stage, with the same hook recipe, not those exact bytes.
